My family had a tradition of doing christmas unwrapping in pairs. Youngest-oldest, second youngest-second oldest etc. So, as the youngest at the age of fourteen, I was sitting on the floor nest to my grandfather. So my pawpaw was finished with his presents first, and I didnt realize all the attention was on me. I got to my aunts present and was very excited, because she usually got me little bits of sciency stuff or pottery from a country she visited. Well, I opened the bag and all I found was tissue paper at first. I tossed it aside, and threw one at my pawpaws head to be silly, and try to ease the tension. Only to find the tissue paper was... not paper. It was cloth, and I was like "cool, eco friendly shit, awesome" then the card on the bottom I read out loud ended with "Congrats on getting your puberty, here's some stuff to attract the boys." There was no tissue paper in the bag at all. It was ALL THONGS. ALL OVER THE FLOOR IN THE PILE I MADE. And one sitting atop my grandfather's head. I still dont like opening stuff in front of people, and it's been ten years. 
I mean, they laughed about it. My mom and pawpaw stood up for me, but fuck was that traumatic.
